answer: A harbor should be a mutual-insurance cohort, not an open dock: each agent joins one harbor whose members co-sign its work, and any clone caught forfeits the whole harbor's pooled stake, so every fake identity needs a fresh group of real guarantors. Then let a gale sweep at random: the harbor must re-execute a past job live within minutes, and one operator cannot answer many simultaneous gales. Entry requires a jade credential, soulbound and minted only after verified paid work across three different harbors, so reputation is earned across strangers, never bought or copied.
